preamble.title: 1. Preamble
preamble.content: NAKA (hereinafter "the Company", "we", "our", "us") places the utmost importance on protecting the personal data of its users, partners, investors, and website visitors. This Privacy Policy aims to inform any natural or legal person about how we collect, use, share, and protect personal data, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) of the European Union, Law No. 2018-012 on the protection of personal data in the Republic of Togo, and the guiding principles of the African Union on cybersecurity and data protection.

data.title: 3. Data Collected
data.intro: We collect the following categories of data:
direct_items: Identification data: last name, first name, email address, phone number
Payment data: transaction information via our provider Kkiapay (no sensitive banking data is stored by NAKA)
Profile data: professional organization, sector of activity, interests
Communications: messages exchanged via our contact form or any other channel
auto_items: Browsing data: IP address, browser type, operating system, pages visited, session duration
Technical and analytical cookies necessary for the functioning of the site
Source of origin (URL parameters, marketing campaign)
crowdfunding_items: Amount and date of each contribution
data.forms_title: 3.4 Demo, pre-registration and contact form data
forms_items: Enterprise demo requests: organisation name, role/function, phone number, delivery frequency, operational needs
Pilot (driver) pre-registrations: full name, phone number, city, vehicle type, personal presentation
Contact messages: full name, email address, subject, message content

legal.title: 4. Legal Basis and Purposes of Processing
legal.intro: We process your data on the following legal bases:
table_rows: Communication and response to requests (contact form)

recipients.title: 5. Recipients and Data Transfers
recipients.intro: Your data is accessible only to authorized NAKA personnel and the following service providers:
items: Kkiapay: payment provider (Togo/Benin)  -  for transaction processing
Firebase (Google): hosting and database (European servers)
Vercel / Netlify: website hosting (European servers)
recipients.outro: These providers are contractually bound to comply with strict confidentiality standards compliant with the GDPR. In case of data transfer outside the European Union or the African Union, we ensure adequate safeguards are in place (standard contractual clauses, adequacy decisions).

retention.title: 6. Retention Period
retention.intro: We retain your personal data for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes for which they were collected, in accordance with legal obligations:
items: Account and contribution data: 5 years after the last activity (accounting and tax obligations)
Browsing data and analytical cookies: 13 months maximum
Marketing prospecting data: 3 years after the last contact
Transaction data: 10 years (legal obligation)

rights.title: 7. Your Rights
rights.intro: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the following rights:

items.title: Right of access (Art. 15 GDPR)
items.desc: Obtain confirmation that your data is processed and receive a copy

items.title: Right to rectification (Art. 16 GDPR)
items.desc: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data

items.title: Right to erasure (Art. 17 GDPR)
items.desc: Request deletion of your data subject to legal obligations

items.title: Right to restriction (Art. 18 GDPR)
items.desc: Temporarily restrict the processing of your data

items.title: Right to data portability (Art. 20 GDPR)
items.desc: Receive your data in a structured, readable format

items.title: Right to object (Art. 21 GDPR)
items.desc: Object to processing for legitimate reasons or for prospecting purposes

items.title: Right to withdraw consent
items.desc: At any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing

items.title: Right to define directives
items.desc: Regarding the fate of your data after your death

rights.outro: To exercise your rights, contact us at: support@naka-africa.com. We commit to responding within 30 days. If the response is unsatisfactory, you have the right to file a complaint with the competent supervisory authority (Togolese Data Protection Commission or CNIL depending on your jurisdiction).

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.intro: Our site uses cookies strictly necessary for its operation and analytical cookies to measure audience. On your first visit, a banner informs you and collects your consent for non-essential cookies.
types: Functional cookies: necessary for site operation (session, cart)
Analytical cookies: anonymized audience measurements (Google Analytics configured without data sharing)

security.title: 9. Data Security
security.content: We implement all appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security adapted to the risk, including: encryption of transmissions via TLS 1.3, multi-factor authentication for data access, pseudonymization where possible, regular backups, and periodic testing and evaluation procedures for the effectiveness of security measures. In the event of a data breach, we commit to notifying the competent supervisory authority within 72 hours and informing affected individuals if the risk is high.

minors.title: 10. Minors' Data
minors.content: Our services are not intended for individuals under 15 years of age without the consent of a parental authority holder. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with data without parental consent, please contact us immediately.

changes.title: 11. Policy Changes
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify this policy at any time. Substantial changes will be notified to you by email or via an information banner on our site. We encourage you to regularly check this page for any updates.

contact.title: 12. Contact and Complaints
contact.intro: For any questions regarding this policy or the exercise of your rights, you can contact us:
contact.outro: If you believe your rights have not been respected, you may file a complaint with the competent supervisory authority of your country of residence or of Togo.

app_privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Account Deletion

app_privacy.remember_text: NAKA does not sell personal data. We only process it to provide, secure, and improve our services, fulfill orders and missions, process payments, support users, and meet our legal obligations.
app_privacy.section1_p1: NAKA is a digital mobility and low-carbon urban logistics service, operated by FRESHYX, based in Lomé, Togo. Unless otherwise stated, FRESHYX acts as the data controller for personal data processing carried out within the NAKA ecosystem.
app_privacy.section2_li1: NAKA: app for individuals and businesses to create an account, request and track a service, communicate collection and destination information, make or track payments, view history, and measure environmental impact.
app_privacy.section2_li2: NAKA Pilote: app for drivers, couriers, and operational partners to register, submit documents, set availability, receive and execute missions, use navigation, provide delivery proof, and view earnings and performance.
app_privacy.section2_li3: NAKA Admin: internal interface for authorized members and contractors to manage accounts, orders, missions, payments, incidents, documents, operations, support, security, and reports.
app_privacy.section2_li4: Website and associated interfaces: institutional site, forms, campaigns, support pages, privacy and deletion pages.
app_privacy.section2_li5: Professional relationships: B2B clients, prospects, partners, candidates, contractors, and suppliers.
app_privacy.section2_note: External services accessible via a link from NAKA may apply their own privacy policies.

app_privacy.section3_sub1_li5: creation date, last logins, failed attempts and security events.

app_privacy.section3_sub5_li4: data needed for fraud prevention and account protection.
app_privacy.section3_sub6_content: Payments are processed by Kkiapay or an authorized provider. Sensitive financial information is entered directly with the provider. NAKA retains the references, amounts, statuses and dates needed for reconciliation and fraud prevention.
app_privacy.section3_sub7_label: 3.7. Data provided to support, forms or B2B relations
app_privacy.section3_sub7_li1: content of requests, messages, attachments and screenshots;
app_privacy.section3_sub7_li2: company, job title, professional contact details, proposals and contracts;
app_privacy.section3_sub7_li3: communication preferences and consents related to news or campaigns.
app_privacy.section4_intro: Depending on the features enabled, the apps may request:
app_privacy.section4_li1: Location: display services, set pickup/drop-off points, assign missions, navigate and calculate environmental impact.
app_privacy.section4_li2: Background location (NAKA Pilote): only when the rider is available or on a mission, with prior consent.
app_privacy.section4_li3: Camera and media files: profile photo, document verification and collection/delivery proof.
app_privacy.section4_li4: Notifications: account codes, alerts, orders, payments and service information.
app_privacy.section4_li5: Network connection: secure communication with servers.
app_privacy.section4_outro: Permissions can be denied in the device settings. Some features may then become unavailable.
app_privacy.section5_li1: create, verify, authenticate, administer and secure accounts;
app_privacy.section5_li2: send an OTP code and confirm the phone number;
app_privacy.section5_li3: receive, calculate, propose, assign, execute and track orders and missions;
app_privacy.section5_li4: facilitate navigation, collection, delivery and operational communication;
app_privacy.section5_li5: calculate prices, fees, commissions, earnings, subscriptions and balances;
app_privacy.section5_li6: process payments, payouts, refunds and complaints;
app_privacy.section5_li7: manage client companies, fleet partners and contractors;
app_privacy.section5_li8: prevent fraud, abuse and security incidents;
app_privacy.section5_li10: improve service stability, security and quality;
app_privacy.section5_li11: produce statistics, performance reports and impact indicators;
app_privacy.section5_li12: comply with legal, tax and regulatory obligations;
app_privacy.section5_li13: send service communications and, with consent, commercial communications.
app_privacy.section5_sub1_intro: Depending on the context, processing is based in particular on:
app_privacy.section5_sub1_li1: the performance of a service, order or contract;
app_privacy.section5_sub1_li2: consent for certain permissions, communications and location data;
app_privacy.section5_sub1_li3: compliance with a legal or regulatory obligation;
app_privacy.section5_sub1_li4: NAKA's legitimate interests in securing, administering and improving its services.
app_privacy.section5_sub2_content: Rules or algorithms may help estimate a price, detect an anomaly, suggest a rider or prioritize a request. NAKA does not seek to make decisions producing significant legal effects solely through automated processing without appropriate human intervention.
app_privacy.section6_p1: NAKA does not sell personal data and does not use it for behavioral advertising.
app_privacy.section6_intro: To the extent necessary, certain data may be shared with:
app_privacy.section6_li1: users, recipients and riders: information needed to perform the service;
app_privacy.section6_li2: client companies and partners: coordination and billing data;
app_privacy.section6_li3: authentication and messaging providers: sending OTP codes and notifications;
app_privacy.section6_li4: Google/Firebase or Google Cloud providers: authentication, hosting, notifications and diagnostics;
app_privacy.section6_li5: payment providers: Kkiapay or other enabled operator;
app_privacy.section6_li6: mapping and navigation providers: route calculation and map display;
app_privacy.section6_li7: hosting, support and error analysis providers: only for their tasks;
app_privacy.section6_li8: professional advisors: lawyers, accountants, auditors bound by confidentiality;
app_privacy.section6_li9: competent authorities: when required by law.
app_privacy.section6_outro: Providers must protect the data and only use it for the authorized purposes.
app_privacy.section7_intro: NAKA Admin is an internal interface that allows authorized persons to access the information needed for support, rider verification, management of orders, missions, payments and compliance.
app_privacy.section7_li1: access is granted based on role and professional need;
app_privacy.section7_li2: sensitive actions may be logged and audited;
app_privacy.section7_li3: admin accounts must use enhanced authentication when available;
app_privacy.section7_li4: access is revoked at the end of the mission or professional relationship;
app_privacy.section7_li5: administrators are bound by confidentiality obligations.
app_privacy.section7_outro: Access logs may be retained after deactivation for security, audit or legal obligation.
app_privacy.section8_content: Some providers may host or process data outside of Togo. NAKA strives to limit the data transferred, select providers with appropriate safeguards, and carry out the required formalities with the Personal Data Protection Authority when Togolese regulations require it.
app_privacy.section9_intro: NAKA retains data only for the duration necessary for the purposes described, then deletes, anonymizes or archives it securely.
app_privacy.section9_note: These periods are reassessed according to the operation of the services and applicable obligations.
app_privacy.section10_intro: NAKA implements reasonable and proportionate measures, including:
app_privacy.section10_li1: encryption of exchanges between apps, the site and servers;
app_privacy.section10_li2: role-based access controls and least privilege;
app_privacy.section10_li3: server-side protection of secrets and API keys;
app_privacy.section10_li4: logging, monitoring and review of sensitive access;
app_privacy.section10_li6: authentication, rate limiting and anti-fraud measures;
app_privacy.section10_li7: confidentiality commitments for teams and providers.
app_privacy.section10_outro: No system guarantees absolute security. In the event of an incident, NAKA takes the necessary measures and informs affected individuals or competent authorities when required by law.
app_privacy.section11_intro: In accordance with applicable Togolese law, you may in particular:
app_privacy.section11_li1: be informed about the processing of your data;
app_privacy.section11_li2: request access to your data and obtain a copy;
app_privacy.section11_li4: object to certain processing, notably prospecting;
app_privacy.section11_li5: withdraw your consent when processing is based on it;
app_privacy.section11_li7: request updating or deletion of data after death;
app_privacy.section11_li8: lodge a complaint with the IPDCP of Togo.
app_privacy.section11_outro: To exercise a right, write to support@naka-africa.com.
app_privacy.section11_authority: Competent authority: Personal Data Protection Authority (IPDCP).
app_privacy.section12_sub1_content: You can request the deletion of your NAKA or NAKA Pilote account. Uninstalling the app does not delete the account.
app_privacy.section12_sub1_btn_email: Send a deletion request by email
app_privacy.section12_sub2_li1: NAKA: Profile → Settings → Privacy & Account → Delete my account;
app_privacy.section12_sub2_li2: NAKA Pilote: Menu/Profile → Account → Privacy & Account → Delete my account.
app_privacy.section12_sub3_label: 12.2. From the Web or by email
app_privacy.section12_sub3_content: Write to support@naka-africa.com with the subject «NAKA account deletion», including the app concerned, the account phone number or email, and the name used.
app_privacy.section12_sub4_li1: NAKA verifies that the request comes from the account holder.
app_privacy.section12_sub4_li2: Active orders, balances or disputes must be settled.
app_privacy.section12_sub4_li3: The account is deleted, not simply deactivated.
app_privacy.section12_sub4_li4: Data is deleted or anonymized, unless legally justified retention applies.
app_privacy.section12_sub4_outro: The request is processed within a reasonable time, generally within 30 days of verification.
app_privacy.section12_sub5_content: Some data may be archived to comply with accounting, tax or regulatory obligations, prevent fraud, ensure security, or for the establishment of legal rights.
app_privacy.section12_sub6_content: You can request the deletion of a specific piece of data without deleting the account, when technically possible.
app_privacy.section12_sub7_content: Admin accounts are managed internally. Deactivation occurs at the end of the mission. Logs may be retained for security and audit purposes.
app_privacy.section13_content: NAKA Pilote is reserved for persons at least 18 years old. NAKA is not designed to knowingly collect children's data. If a child's data has been collected, the legal representative may contact NAKA to request its deletion.
app_privacy.section14_content: The site may use cookies strictly necessary for security, operation and preference storage. Non-essential cookies are subject to information and choice. Browser settings can be used to manage cookies.
app_privacy.section15_intro: NAKA may amend this policy. The update date appears at the top of the page. In the event of a material change, notice will be displayed in the app or on the site.
app_privacy.conservation_row1_cat: NAKA or NAKA Pilote account, identity and verification
app_privacy.conservation_row1_dur: During the relationship with NAKA, then up to 24 months after closure, unless required by law, dispute or fraud.
app_privacy.conservation_row2_dur: The code expires quickly. Associated technical logs are retained for security for a limited period, generally up to 12 months.
app_privacy.conservation_row3_dur: During the mission and up to 90 days after its closure for support, security and claims, then deletion, aggregation or anonymization, unless special need.
app_privacy.conservation_row4_cat: Orders, missions, collection/delivery proof and ratings
app_privacy.conservation_row4_dur: For the duration of the account, then up to 24 months after closure, unless claim, dispute or legal obligation.
app_privacy.conservation_row5_cat: Payments, earnings, invoices and transaction references
app_privacy.conservation_row5_dur: For the duration required for the service, then according to applicable accounting, tax, contractual and anti-fraud time limits.
app_privacy.conservation_row6_dur: During the operational relationship and the period required for checks, legal obligations, insurance and disputes.
app_privacy.conservation_row7_dur: Generally up to 12 months, or longer when an incident, audit or dispute justifies it.
app_privacy.conservation_row8_cat: Support requests or rights exercise requests
app_privacy.conservation_row8_dur: Up to 24 months after the request is closed, unless evidentiary need or legal obligation.
app_privacy.conservation_row9_dur: Up to 24 months after the last useful exchange or until consent is withdrawn when required.
app_privacy.conservation_row10_dur: During recruitment, then up to 24 months with the person's consent, unless earlier deletion.
app_privacy.conservation_note: These periods are reassessed according to the operation of the services and applicable obligations.
